preconditions.description: The number of settlements is between 1 and 100000, inclusive.
The number of settlements affected by the Book of Evil is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The damage range of the Book of Evil is between 0 and n - 1, inclusive.
Each affected settlement number is between 1 and n, inclusive.
Each path connects two distinct settlements.

preconditions.expression: The graph formed by the settlements and paths is connected
preconditions.description: It is possible to reach any settlement from any other one by traversing one or several paths.

postconditions.description: The output is either 0 or a number of settlements that may contain the Book of Evil, which is at most n.

postconditions.expression: all(distance(p_i, x) <= d for x in range(1, n + 1) for p_i in affected_settlements)
postconditions.description: For each affected settlement, all other settlements are within the damage range d.

postconditions.expression: output == 0 or any(distance(x, p_i) <= d for x in range(1, n + 1) for p_i in affected_settlements)
postconditions.description: There exists at least one settlement that may contain the Book of Evil, such that all affected settlements are within the damage range d from it.
